title: ABC: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
abstract: ABC is a fully open-source stack for manipulation with behavior cloning. At its core is ABC-130K: the largest open-source teleoperation dataset to date, featuring 3,553 hours of bimanual data across 134,806 episodes and 195 tasks, collected on an $8,000 YAM station. It further open-sources the hardware setup, training infrastructure (ABC-Models: DiT and VLA policies), and simulation pipeline (ABC-Sim: 400 hours of sim-teleop data across 10 tasks). A co-training recipe produces correlated simulation and real-world evaluation (Pearson r=0.85-0.91), offering a reliable proxy for ablating model-design decisions before costly real-world evaluation. Resulting policies execute dexterous tasks such as box folding and extracting credit cards from wallets.
nature: System design + Empirical (open-source stack: data + models + sim + eval)
